ownerReview.review: KJV remaining New Testament complete-context review

edits.expected: the communication of thy faith may become effectual
edits.replacement: thy participation in the faith may become effective
edits.reason: Communication is fellowship/participation in this context, not merely transmitting information or an evangelism technique; preserves recognition of good in you and in Christ of this base.

edits.expected: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the hearts of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

edits.expected: I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient
edits.replacement: I could be very bold in Christ to command thee to do what is fitting
edits.reason: Old much bold and enjoin are clarified; convenient means fitting/right in this appeal, not personal ease. Keeps could command in contrast to request for love.

edits.expected: Not now as a servant, but above a servant
edits.replacement: No longer as a slave, but more than a slave
edits.reason: Historical slavery in this personal case, not all instances of servant in every biblical context. Keeps beloved brother and flesh/Lord, without adding an explicit legal emancipation statement.

edits.expected: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
edits.replacement: Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus, greets thee;
edits.reason: Singular Epaphras requires greets; the apposition identifies Epaphras as fellowprisoner, not the addressee. Retains the earlier greeting clarification without misplaced modifier.
